messages:
Sam: Heads-up: I'm prototyping the Permissions panel copy for showing routing-policy effects and quota impact for roles. Need quick gut-checks before I wire telemetry.
Maya: Nice. Are you planning to show per-route token usage projections or just current quota allocations?
Sam: Both ideally. Small inline preview: show expected QPS and monthly token delta if role can hit route X. Want to avoid overwhelming admins.
Liam: +1 for projections. We have enough telemetry to back a 30d rolling projection. But compute cost could be nontrivial for tenants with many routes.
Ana: Could we lazy-evaluate projections on hover/click? e.g., show a lightweight estimate first and a detailed projection on demand.
Sam: That's what I sketched: summary row with "est. monthly tokens" and a chevron to expand details. Minimal by default.
Rebecca: One concern: expansion needs to show which kernel/model variant would be used for that route (because cost varies widely). Otherwise the estimate will be misleading.
Sam: Good point. Proposal: show model variant and quantization profile used in the projection, plus a link "view assumptions" that opens a tiny modal with the exact config.
Maya: UX thing: avoid wordy modal. Maybe a tooltip with a short bulleted list + "view full assumptions" link to docs.
Liam: Implementation note: we can reuse the existing telemetry endpoint /api/tenants/:id/usage-projections which already accepts a modelVariant param. Sample payload:```json
{
  "routes": ["/chat/v1","/embed/v1"],
  "window_days": 30,
  "modelVariant": "redwood-l2-8q"
}
```
ops-bot: @Sam FYI there was a spike when projections ran for tenant: acme-corp last week — throttled the job. Keep batching small.
Sam: Thanks @ops-bot — we'll queue and backoff. Plan to run projections on-demand and asynchronously for big tenants.
Ana: Also need permission affordance: only tenant admins and auditors should see detailed projections (they reveal usage patterns). Editors get summary only.
Rebecca: Agree. Add a copy line: "Detailed projection visible to tenant admins and auditors only" and a padlock icon.
Maya: Another thought: when previewing route-affinity changes (e.g., moving route from shared to dedicated) show delta for latency and cost. Even a cheeky green/red dot helps.
Sam: I'll mock up a compact delta UI: small colored pill: "-12% cost" "+4ms p95" next to the route.
Liam: Need to surface fallback policy in the projection too: if dedicated capacity is exhausted we will route to fallback model — that affects cost/latency.
Sam: Right — add line "fallback: shared-l1" under assumptions.
Rebecca: Question on entitlements: when a role's scope includes 'route:write' but excludes 'route:affinity', we need to show what they can/cannot change. UI could gray out affinity controls with hover explaining why.
Ana: Yes, good accessibility practice to include keyboard focusable disabled tooltip.
Maya: One last API note: expose an endpoint to preview "what-if" changes without persisting (PATCH /api/roles/:id/preview) returning projection + permission diffs. That keeps frontend simple.
Liam: Backend: we can implement that as a dry-run in the role-service; reuse policy-eval, then call usage-projection. Estimated added load: 10ms per role + projection time.
Sam: Cool. I'll update the mock and expecations. Who wants a look at the Figma frames before I open the PR?
Maya: Send frames here when ready, I'll review microcopy.
Rebecca: I'll check the permission flows and tooltip texts.
Ana: I'll test screen-reader labels.
Sam: Thanks team — will post link in this thread once frames are up. :thumbsup:
